name: Little Red Hunts the Wolf
source:
[b]"We all know how this story ends."[/b]

A short (?) VN between a hunter dressed in red and a wolf. (Yes, you can romance the wolf.) 

[Edited from [url=https://drowzyartist.itch.io/little-red-hunts-the-wolf]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]「我們都知道這個故事會怎麼收場。」[/b]

一部講述紅衣獵人與狼的短篇（？）視覺小說。沒錯，你可以跟狼談戀愛。

［編譯自[url=https://drowzyartist.itch.io/little-red-hunts-the-wolf]itch.io[/url]］
